tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Tenderer has to upload all qualifying documents as mentioned in tender documents and also should upload dully filled and signed tender form with seal and signature ( technical part )
The bidders agrees and abides for all the terms and conditions specification in the tender document laid down by the CHIMUL
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer/contractor / authorised service providers should have satisfactorly executed similar to the type of work specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity during last 3 years
The insurance Company, which is registered with the Insurance regulatory authority, only will be considered for evaluation. The insurance brokers are not qualified to participate in the process

The tenderer should furnish the financial status of the organization for the last three years premium, claims settlement,profitability etc and also the IRDA Registration number to be quoted along with the tender
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Last 3 Years Annual Turnover Certificates certified by Charted Accountant
Past Experience PO copies should enclose with performance certificate
